subject: Bulb mystery and a tiny favor
text: My smart bulb keeps turning itself off every few minutes, and I think the Wi-Fi extender upstairs is being dramatic. Would you mind looking at it for two seconds when you get a chance? You always know the settings menu, and I don’t want to keep restarting the router at midnight. If it’s too much, tell me. I can wait until the weekend, but it’s driving me a little nuts while reading. Also, if the lamp stays dark, could you maybe borrow the small screwdriver? Mine is hiding somewhere behind the toolbox. I’d buy you coffee tomorrow, or bring over that leftover lemon cake you liked last month. No pressure at all, just let me know if you’re home later.
